notes.text: In the linked passage, Elazar ben Yehudah Ish Avalim transmits a teaching in Rabbi Yaakov’s name.

Ish Avalim preserves איש אבלים without deciding its geographical or descriptive sense. Elazar ben Yehudah Ish Avalim is the supplied body name; neither unit supplies a personal title. See also [Heilprin’s entry, which gives other spellings](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=514&lang=en).
